answer: Task rights are earned by teaching, not claiming. First, the network pairs each applicant with a randomly assigned learner and one skill. Second, the applicant teaches up to three sessions around a before-and-after benchmark. Third, an independent scorer activates it only on a 10% gain; failure locks it out seven days. A gale of 100 fakes means teaching 100 strangers: a glacier of 300 half-hour sessions, 150 hours, $300 at $2 per hour, plus a week per failure. A raven earns its place by teaching its call to another bird; an agent that cannot lift a stranger has not earned one.
